what: FOUND 2026-09-22 while implementing E42; NOT fixed in that PR, deliberately, because it widens a Tier-2 change beyond what was dispatched. E42 makes `src/main.py::_resolve_tick_symbols` fetch UNION(roster-implied, declared), so a stale pull list can no longer stop a rostered leg trading. THREE OTHER READERS OF `accounts.yaml::symbols` WERE NOT CHANGED and still take the DECLARED list alone: (1) `src/units/accounts/clients.py::account_bybit_open_orders` -- the per-symbol POSITION cross-check that exists because a settleCoin page can silently OMIT a live symbol (BL-20260713-BYBIT2-BTC-SETTLECOIN-BLIND); (2) `clients.py::account_bybit_raw_positions` via `_bybit_configured_symbols`, same shape; (3) `src/runtime/exchange_accounts.py::bybit_fill_accounts` -- the live fill/cost sweep. [!] THE CONSEQUENCE IS THE SHARPER HALF OF THE ORIGINAL DEFECT, not a cosmetic one: a rostered symbol absent from the pull list would now TRADE (E42's fix) while remaining invisible to the naked-position cross-check and to the cost sweep. Before E42 it simply did not trade, so the two readers had nothing to miss. That is a real, if narrow, money-at-risk surface and it is the price of the E42 fix, stated rather than hidden. [!] WHAT HOLDS IT SHUT IN THE MEANTIME: `scripts/ci/check_roster_symbol_reachability.py` fails any PR that creates the condition, and it is MEASURED green on the tree today (0 unreachable). So the exposure requires a config edit landing past a red CI, not an unnoticed drift. That is a guard, not a fix. [!] THE RIGHT FIX IS ONE SHARED RESOLVER, not three more unions: a single `symbols_for_account(account) -> list` that both the tick and the data readers call, so the next reader added cannot repeat this. Tier-2 (the Bybit read paths).
